training.controller: unchanged native policy and unweighted raw depth residual inputs
training.effect_scope: local weighting plus native controller response, not identical realized lambda_V trajectories

local_weight.input: absolute difference of frozen prior and DA3 targets on the same ray
local_weight.threshold_policy: pooled training-only input discrepancy Q50/Q90, equal region sample counts; one shared metric pair frozen before training
local_weight.sampling: deterministic uniformly spaced valid flattened indices; equally subsample each region to common count
local_weight.validity: finite strictly positive target; preserve native finite prediction validity in loss
local_weight.missing_source: single available source has local multiplier one; neither available has zero depth loss
local_weight.reduction: native source valid pixel count, never sum of local weights
local_weight.interpretation: discrepancy-based allocation policy; not probability of correct image depth

runtime.finish_policy: user authorized completion without morning deadline

evaluation.mesh_role: raw TSDF primary and postprocessed secondary, same resolution as existing anchor/final512 comparisons
